todaysEvents.delta: Yahoo Finance Oct 18: Brent BZ=F $108.44 (-1.293%) and WTI CL=F $97.91 (-1.121%). These are dated instrument snapshots.
Trading Economics Oct 16: Japan-Korea LNG CFD reference $29.93/MMBtu (+12.79%). This is separate from official JKM $22/MMBtu (Reuters Jul 24, carried).

Oct 18 source search found no newer approved security update than Reuters Oct 16 Yanbu missile interception. The latest comparable reviewed Hormuz count remains seven commodity vessels on Oct 6; no current trapped-tanker count is verified.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Mediation produces agreed sequencing and monitored reopening. Iran said the US reply to its seven conditions was insufficient; a signed deal and durable shipping normalisation remain unverified after the Oct 14 vessel sinkings.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.summary: Selective passage continues amid shipping disruptions.
scenarios.description: Selective Hormuz passage and export rerouting coexist with new shipping incidents and vessel losses. The Oct 6 count remains the latest comparable transit count; replacement-supply, freight and cargo-cost observations remain incomplete.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.summary: Talks stall or attacks disrupt more export routes.
scenarios.description: Sequencing disagreements persist or attacks further disrupt Hormuz and alternative export routes. Two vessels have sunk near Hormuz; war-risk insurance, route-normalised freight and replacement LNG costs remain unverified.
